audit_target_contract.presentation_claim: A helmeted, goggle-wearing skier stands on a snowy mountain ridge holding a camera toward the viewer, with snow-covered peaks and distant valleys in the background.

video_describe.brief_video_summary: A helmeted, goggle-wearing skier stands on a snowy mountain ridge holding a camera toward the viewer, with snow-covered peaks and distant valleys in the background.

items.what_to_verify: Do the helmet and goggles maintain consistent shape, position, and occlusion relative to the face across all frames?
items.anomaly_definition: An anomaly would be unexplained deformation, detachment, sliding, or inconsistent occlusion of the helmet or goggles relative to the face.
minimum_checks: Compare the helmet outline and goggle placement at the beginning, middle, and end of the clip.
Track the goggles relative to the eyes and helmet across consecutive frames while accounting for head rotation.

items.what_to_verify: Are the backpack straps and buckles consistently visible and attached to the skier's shoulders and torso across all frames?
items.anomaly_definition: An anomaly would be a strap or buckle detaching, changing attachment point, duplicating, disappearing without occlusion, or moving inconsistently with the torso.
minimum_checks: Track each visible strap from the shoulder toward the backpack across the sequence.
Compare buckle and strap positions before and after changes in the skier's posture.
Distinguish temporary occlusion by the jacket or helmet from actual disappearance.

items.what_to_verify: Whether the background mountain contours retain coherent geometry as the skier moves.
items.anomaly_definition: An anomaly would be unexplained warping, duplication, or discontinuous displacement of the distant ridgelines between frames.
minimum_checks: Compare prominent ridge peaks at the beginning, middle, and end of the clip.
Inspect the ridgeline boundaries for discontinuities unrelated to foreground occlusion.

findings.observation: Helmet and goggles remain fixed in position and shape, with no warping, detachment, or inconsistent occlusion.
Straps remain taut and buckles stay in place, showing no slippage, detachment, or inconsistent geometry.
The distant ridgelines retain consistent contours and relative placement throughout the sampled frames.

evidence_assessment.reason: Helmet and goggles remain fixed in position and shape, with no warping, detachment, or inconsistent occlusion.
Straps remain taut and buckles stay in place, showing no slippage, detachment, or inconsistent geometry.
The distant ridgelines retain consistent contours and relative placement throughout the sampled frames.

audit.aggregation: Other inspected observations: Helmet and goggles remain fixed in position and shape, with no warping, detachment, or inconsistent occlusion. Straps remain taut and buckles stay in place, showing no slippage, detachment, or inconsistent geometry. The distant ridgelines retain consistent contours and relative placement throughout the sampled frames.
